source_documents.title: Excited state dynamics of azulene and its derivatives: The impact of energy gap and vibronic coupling on anti-Kasha emission in solution

reference_evidence_units.subject: Az-OH / 2-hydroxyazulene
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 1; same computational level as subsequent dynamics.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Calculated S1/S2 vertical energies are 2.78/3.65 eV, oscillator strengths 0.008/0.019 and gap 0.87 eV.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Vertical gap is not an adiabatic/0-0 energy. Source designation, not confirmed candidate SMILES.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The initial wavefunction is vertically excited into the S2 state at the FC
reference_evidence_units.subject: Az, Az-Cl, Az-OH, Az-NMe2
reference_evidence_units.conditions: F053 LVC/MCTDH two-singlet-state model; TDDFT B3LYP/TZP with COSMO cyclohexane; selected normal modes; first 20 ps after S0-to-S2 excitation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The model initializes S2 at the Franck-Condon geometry and evolves selected nuclear degrees of freedom; convergence checks are described for early propagation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Two excited singlets and selected modes, not full-dimensional S0/S1/S2/triplet/emission dynamics; SI convergence figures not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.subject: Four azulenes; target Az-OH
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solution PLQY values from external experimental ref44, quoted in the main text.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Az-OH is assigned experimental PLQY 5 x10^-5% in the source's comparison, with the order Az > Az-Cl > Az-OH > Az-NMe2.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: F053 did not measure these yields anew; original ref44 not inspected. Preserve percent units, especially the very small OH/NMe2 values.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the exciton population of Az-OH drops rapidly from 96 % to 76 %, followed by a gradual decrease to ca. 68 % by 20 ps.
reference_evidence_units.subject: Az-OH
reference_evidence_units.conditions: F053 LVC/MCTDH two-singlet-state model; TDDFT B3LYP/TZP with COSMO cyclohexane; selected normal modes; first 20 ps after S0-to-S2 excitation. Figure 5 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Az-OH S2 population drops from 96% to 76% during 0.3-4 ps and reaches 68.2% at 20 ps.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Remaining S2 population at 20 ps is not fluorescence yield, experimental lifetime, or emission intensity.

reference_evidence_units.quote: stretching along C-O bond, which is observed for Q6 and Q11 normal modes of Az- OH
reference_evidence_units.subject: Az-OH
reference_evidence_units.conditions: F053 LVC/MCTDH two-singlet-state model; TDDFT B3LYP/TZP with COSMO cyclohexane; selected normal modes; first 20 ps after S0-to-S2 excitation. Main-text description of selected vibrational modes.
reference_evidence_units.statement: C-O stretching modes Q6/Q11 contribute large intrastate couplings. Core modes Q15/Q37/Q42 resemble important azulene core motions.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Mode assignments/couplings are computational; referenced SI mode tables not personally inspected.

reference_evidence_units.subject: Az-OH
reference_evidence_units.conditions: F053 LVC/MCTDH two-singlet-state model; TDDFT B3LYP/TZP with COSMO cyclohexane; selected normal modes; first 20 ps after S0-to-S2 excitation. Table 2 and Figure 5 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Turning off Q15/Q37/Q42 raises 20 ps S2 population from 68.2% to 76.7%; those core modes account for 26.7% of modeled decay.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Virtual mode removal is not physical rigidification by aggregation. It isolates only the chosen model degrees of freedom.

reference_evidence_units.quote: both the shape of the curves and the amount of the population loss are different in these simulations
reference_evidence_units.subject: Parent Az with artificially changed energy gaps
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Az Hamiltonian with gap set to 1.10, 0.87 or 0.56 eV, compared with actual derivative Hamiltonians.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The parent-Az gap-only controls do not reproduce substituted compounds; coupling/structure matters as well as gap.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Counterfactual controls on Az, not additional target dynamics or measured target yields.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The rate of the non-radiative decay of the S2 state for all compounds correlates well with the decrease of their anti-Kasha photoluminescence quantum yield
reference_evidence_units.subject: Az and derivatives including Az-OH
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Comparison of modeled early S2 loss with cited experimental PLQY ordering.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors interpret early S2-to-S1 nonradiative loss and the gap/coupling interplay as determinants of relative anti-Kasha efficiency.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Correlation across four compounds and a 20 ps model, not calculation of absolute radiative yields or definitive exclusive causation.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Source quantitatively models competing excited-state population loss and links it to emission efficiency; preserve limited time window and non-equivalence of population and PLQY.

reference_mechanisms.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Retain source's explicit anti-Kasha S2-emission interpretation for this very weak or weak emitter; no minimum yield threshold is imposed.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Virtual mode ablation demonstrates vibrational contributions but not actual motion restriction causing target aggregation enhancement. No positive RIM label.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific external packing or matrix confinement mechanism established in the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific binding of a guest, solvent or analyte that alters emission established.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific charge-transfer excited-state mechanism established in the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer pathway established; hydrogen bonding or an OH substituent alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on established; CT-state character is not by itself a separate PET process.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific aggregate exciton, excimer or exciplex emission established; aggregation alone does not establish this family.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Source quantitatively models competing excited-state population loss and links it to emission efficiency; preserve limited time window and non-equivalence of population and PLQY.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-centered or energy-transfer mechanism established by the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Source discusses S1/S2 crossing points in model diabatic cuts, but does not establish target-specific conical-intersection-mediated nonradiative decay or restricted CI access. Do not import parent Az's literature S1/S0 CI claim.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Retain source's explicit anti-Kasha S2-emission interpretation for this very weak or weak emitter; no minimum yield threshold is imposed.
